catalog.nvfp4Search: Sediba se se Ntsho GPU ka memori e lekaneng e behilweng e lemohilwe. Rata bogolo NVFP4 diphetogo fa boagi le enjene di di tshegetsa. Semelafa FLUX.2 Klein 4B Comfy loading e teng mo metsweding ya selegae; tlhola CUDA PyTorch, ditshegetso tsa boikgethelo, dikai tsa molekane le memori wa mahala pele o laisolola. Temogo ya serweboleta ga e netefatse nako ya go dira e e rulagantsweng kgotsa lebelo la netefatso.
catalog.nvfp4Prefer: NVFP4 e tshitshinngwa mo lelapeng leno la GPU le FLUX.2 Klein 4B. Go laisa ga tlholego go tlhoka thulaganyo ya Comfy e e tshegediwang, CUDA PyTorch le ditshegetso tsa boikgethelo. Tlhopha sekao sa setshwantsho, sekhoutu sa Qwen3 le VAE ka go kgaogana mo diseting tsa Tlhamo. The runtime, feletseng motswako le mahala memoring ya ntse hloka netefatso.
catalog.nvfp4Check: NVFP4 e lemogilwe: bokgoni jwa GPU, memori wa mahala, thulaganyo ya bokete kgotsa tshegetso ya boagi ga e a netefadiwa. Tlhola enjene ya CUDA pele ga o tlhopha mofuta ono. Fomete e le nosi ga e tlhome go tsamaisana.
catalog.nvfp4Unsupported: NVFP4 ya tlholego ga e a atlenegisiwa ka GPU e e lemogilweng kgotsa VRAM ya ga jaana e e sa duelelweng. Akanyetsa tekanyetso e e tsamaelanang ya GGUF kgotsa enjene ya go tsamaisana. Tsela eo ga e neele FP4 potlakiso ya tlholego.
catalog.quantQualityAdvice: Novera GGUF kaelo ya dikarolo tsa sekwalwa, setshwantsho le bidio: Q6_K kgotsa kwa godimo ke ntlha ya rona e e tshitshintsweng ya go simolola fa re baya boikanyegi kwa pele; Q4_K_M e lekalekanya boleng le memori. Tsena ke dikgothaletso, eseng monyako wa ho nepahala wa lefatshe kaofela. Dipholo di ikaegile ka sekao le tiro. NVFP4 le dikema tse dingwe tsa go dira dipalo di tlhoka go tsamaisana ga tsone le tshekatsheko ya boleng.
